sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: the top of a tall drum of cream stone banded in steel blue under a dark blue crown, a high door with a carved eye under stone lids. In the floor a great vane like a bellows fan, and beside it an open iris of sliding stone blades looking straight down into the loft far below, where a small vane on a post spins, just splashed. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack hovers over the great vane on twin jets of cyan glowing fluid, its wash turning it, and the lids over the eye begin to lift; the traveller turns to splash the eye before the small vane slows, dwarfed by the drum. Slit windows, friezes of three dots over an upward arc. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream stone, steel blue bands, dark blue, warm slit-window light, cyan jet glow, lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
